xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5224: Cut GitHub API polling: PR listing re-fetched every 30 s per repo despite webhooks

plan.title: Cut GitHub API polling: PR listing re-fetched every 30 s per repo despite webhooks
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Idle, the dashboard spends ~48% of the user pool's hourly GitHub GraphQL bucket and ~14% of its REST bucket (ledger 2026-11-14 02:00-02:40 UTC). pr-cache re-reads the open PR listing of every repo with open PRs every 30 s (stablyai/orca, eltmon/lexerra, eltmon/overdeck), and pipeline-membership re-gathers every project on every 5-minute convergence tick, although PR changes already arrive by webhook for eltmon/overdeck.
narratives.Proposal: Webhooks drive freshness, polling is the fallback. A new policy module (src/lib/overdeck/pr-freshness.ts) holds the TTLs and a webhook-health provider that only the primary dashboard registers from the existing system-health 'smee-relay' row. While it is running, the PR listing's active TTL is 5 min and its idle/closed TTL 15 min (30 s / 5 min otherwise; an UNKNOWN mergeable row keeps 30 s), the membership PR snapshot's TTL is 5 min, and periodic convergence re-gathers a GitHub-tracked project's membership at most every 30 min. pull_request, pull_request_review, check_suite, check_run (created / failing completed) and status webhooks invalidate the repo's caches (even mid-read) and refresh the named issues' derived state through a 6 s per-repo coalescer. Overdeck's own review door and merge.completed refresh regardless of coverage, and a tracker poll that changes an issue's state or labels refreshes that project's membership.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the App pool's close-out spend (closed-issue reaper); that is PAN-5227
- Changing getPrFacts, its 60 s cache, or the merge gate; merge-time decisions keep their targeted reads
- Detecting webhook coverage per repo or adding any new health signal, config key or persisted state
- Subscribing the GitHub App to issues events or installing it on more repos (operator action)
- Changing the pull-request-sync sweep cadence; conversation PR chips stay at 60 s
- Caching gatherMergeEligibility (merge-train merge-next stays an uncached gather)
- Changing the ci-repair, issue-poller, agent or pr-sync callers
- Editing src/dashboard/server/services/issue-data-service.ts (6 lines from its file-size cap)
- Deploying the change; the after-measurement is posted after the Flywheel reloads the dashboard

autoDecisions.summary: The poll tier is chosen by the global webhook-relay health row, not per repo
autoDecisions.rationale: Only eltmon/overdeck delivers webhooks, but orca and lexerra make two-thirds of the 30 s tier's spend; keeping them at 30 s alone costs ~14% of user GraphQL, so the 15% target is unreachable. The issue says to reuse the existing signal, which is the relay row; repo-notes marks expire after 6 h and cannot stand in for coverage. Uncovered repos lag up to 5 min, stated in docs and the PR body.

autoDecisions.summary: The 15% target (NFR-1) applies to the user pool's GraphQL and REST buckets; the App pool figure is reported beside it
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue reports 'user-pool pace'. The App pool is dominated by close-out (~1,240 calls/h, 25%), a separate subsystem now tracked in PAN-5227.

autoDecisions.summary: Membership fallback is 30 min only for GitHub-tracked projects while webhooks are healthy; other trackers keep the 5-minute convergence
autoDecisions.rationale: Linear/Jira/GitLab trackers have no webhook into Overdeck, and their GitHub cost is small (lexerra only).

autoDecisions.summary: The tracker trigger comes from the issue poller (read-model onIssuesChanged), diffed per identifier on state and labels
autoDecisions.rationale: Zero issues webhooks have ever been received; createIssueDelta is index-based and would mark every row changed on an insertion; issue-data-service.ts is 6 lines from its file-size cap.

autoDecisions.summary: Coalescer spacing is 6 s with a leading fire and one trailing fire; check_run triggers only on created or failing completed
autoDecisions.rationale: check_run is ~80% of receipts; 6 s bounds cost at 10 fires/min/repo while keeping worst-case freshness about 7 s, inside the 10 s requirement.

autoDecisions.summary: The after-measurement is posted to the PR after the Flywheel deploys; the PR body carries the before table, the budget model and the recipe
autoDecisions.rationale: Work agents do not deploy; deploys are the Flywheel's pan reload.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep one plan despite more than 25 files in scope
autoDecisions.rationale: The 15% target is one budget across pr-cache and pipeline-membership; both halves share the policy module and the coalescer, and splitting would leave the issue's acceptance target unmeasurable in either PR.

metadata.sizeJustification: 31 files, mostly small edits plus their tests: the 15% budget (NFR-1) spans pr-cache and pipeline-membership, which share one policy module (pr-freshness.ts) and one webhook coalescer; a split would leave the issue's single measurable target unverifiable in either PR. Each item is independently reviewable and commits on its own.
